businessType.title: What kind of business are you setting up?
businessType.subtitle: Pick the option that best describes your store. You can refine details later.

retail.title: Retail store
retail.subtitle: Sell products like fashion, electronics, cosmetics, and more.

restaurant.title: Restaurant
restaurant.subtitle: Sell meals, add-ons, and manage opening hours.

businessType.note: This only affects the setup flow. You can change some settings later.

storeBasics.title: Tell customers who you are
storeBasics.subtitle: Add a registered name and a display name. Then write a short description.
storeBasics.descriptionPlaceholder: What do you sell? What makes you different?

subdomain.title: Choose your store address
subdomain.subtitle: Your subdomain becomes your public link. Keep it short and easy to remember.
subdomain.label: Subdomain
subdomain.rulesBody: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. It must start and end with a letter or number.
subdomain.rule2: Cannot start or end with a hyphen

brand.title: Make your brand stand out
brand.subtitle: Upload a logo and pick colors. You can adjust later.
brand.logoSubtitle: A clear square image works best.
brand.dragDrop: Click to browse or drag and drop

delivery.title: Set delivery zones
delivery.subtitle: Define where you deliver, the fee, and estimated time.
delivery.intro: Self-managed delivery: you set zones, fees and ETAs. No live tracking in MVP.

review.title: Review and submit
review.subtitle: Make sure everything looks right before you submit for review.
review.note: UI only: this screen doesn’t call the server yet. Draft is saved locally so you can resume later.

legal.title: Business Identity & Ownership
legal.subtitle: Provide your official registration details and head office address.

businessAddress.title: Business Address
businessAddress.subtitle: Provide your official registered physical address.

contact.title: Add your store's contact info
contact.subtitle: Help customers reach you and find your physical location. These are optional.
contact.aboutUsPlaceholder: Tell your customers your story, your mission, and what you stand for.
contact.publicWarning: Note: This information will be displayed publicly on your store.

resetDialog.title: Reset draft?
resetDialog.body: This will clear your saved onboarding progress on this device.

resumeModal.title: Welcome Back!
resumeModal.description: We found a saved draft of your store registration. Would you like to pick up where you left off?

industry.title: What specific category is your business?
industry.subtitle: Help us categorize your store for customers to find you easily.
